items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: You know Red Nichols and his Five Pennies? They made a lot of records. I liked them both.

ctx.x: But he told me about a lot of different things out West and all like that, and wasn't any particular trumpet player around at that time that -- Henry Busse, he worked with -- I knew him with Paul Whitman. He was Whitman's trumpet player. And then Red Nichols came along at that time, and he
worked at Roseland, he was a nice trumpet player. You know Red Nichols and his Five Pennies? They made a lot of records. I liked them both.
And then you also -- you didn't work with Bubba Miley.
